haiku.problem: "His young helper" is not in the verses. 1 Timothy 1:2 calls Timothy "my true child in the faith" and says nothing about his age or role as a helper. Only facts from the lesson's verses are allowed.
"The law" is not clear without the passage. The question doesn't say which law, or that Paul is talking about would-be teachers of the law, so it doesn't make sense when asked at random.

Possible missed main question: the card about what the men should stop doing (teaching false doctrines, Prep card 1-7) is central to the passage's title, "Paul Warns Against False Teachers." It is more important than the question about which city Timothy stays in.
